Review before relying on a lead

  1. Open the original public notice and check for a new sale, continuance, or cancellation.
  2. Verify the parcel, owner or entity, and property classification with official county records.
  3. Record evidence links and dates checked.
  4. Research comparable sales, condition, title, taxes, and repair costs independently.
